thread:
maria: quick preflight for embeddings v1->v2 deprecation. want a short checklist before we flip defaults. main risks: auth propagation, quota accounting, cache duplication, and streaming/frames mismatch.
jordan: agree. also need SDK detection so we can apply shim only for known old clients. can we sniff client version in user-agent?
maria: yes, we'll use User-Agent + Accept header heuristics and a tenant opt-in flag. default flow: opt-in header X-Compat: embeddings-v1 for early customers -> per-tenant toggle -> global default.
sam: streaming mismatch is a real CPU hit. legacy clients send a single JSON array response, v2 streams chunks. shim modes: buffer-mode (aggregate stream -> single response), reframe-mode (translate SSE-like chunks to legacy NDJSON), or reject if strict. prefer reframe-mode in sidecar for perf.
li: infra: put shim in an autoscaled sidecar pool behind gateway. need metrics: shim_applied, shim_latency_ms (p50/p95), shim_errors{type}. canary rollout plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 6 weeks. include CPU circuit breaker at 75%.
anya: ML validation: build a 25-sample set; check cos_sim delta < 1e-4 on average between v1 pipeline and shimmed v2. watch for subtle normalization differences (float precision, order of tokens).
ordan: billing/quotas: v1 charged per-embedding unit; v2 charges same units but different rounding. shim must map billing metadata so customers aren't double-billed or underbilled. record original api_version in usage events.
pat: comms: recommend "Deprecation: v1 embeddings retiring in 90 days; shim available for 6 months" plus migration snippets. provide curl + SDK sample and a quick detection script.
maria: security: ensure auth headers passthrough and do not leak tokens to logs. redact in shim logs. also ensure per-tenant allowlist for opt-in.
sam: cache: v1 cache keys used prompt hash + model alias; v2 uses canonical model id + embedding_dim. shim must canonicalize keys to v2 scheme to avoid cache thrash. add unit tests for cache-normalization.
li: observability: add trace tag "compat:embeddings.v1" and sample traces for mapping_errors. create dashboard showing traffic % served by shim and per-tenant fail rate.
anya: edge-case: some customers relied on `dim` absence to auto-detect model defaults; shim should fill embedding_dim if missing but emit a warning event.
jordan: add response headers: X-Deprecated-Version: v1 and Deprecation-Warning: v1 removed in 90d; sample=0.01 (rate-limited).
maria: good. quick example of transform for docs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{"model":"text-sim-v1","dim":1536,"input":"foo"}
-> shim ->
POST /v2/embeddings
{"model":"text-sim-2026","embedding_dim":1536,"input":"foo"}
```
pat: will draft migration doc and coordinate support playbook. who owns the shim binary?
sam: runtime owner. I'll prototype Rust sidecar and a small node dev shim for customers.
deploy-bot: preview created: emb-compat-sidecar-canary-7 on cluster canary-emb-7 :rocket:
maria: thanks. I'll author a brief RFC addendum and open tickets for alias map, eval set, and telemetry. :thumbsup:
